title: How watering works: choose, preview, water
summary: A three-step demonstration of Basil's watering loop.
whyToday: A repeatable mechanic bulletin should teach one visible action from input to result.
hook: Water three flowers in two taps.
narration: How watering works in Basil. First, choose a water droplet near the flowers you want to care for. Basil previews the nearby group, so you can see where the water will spread. Tap again to confirm the action. The flowers are watered together, and the garden records the care. Choose, preview, then water.
sourceNote: Mechanic explanation grounded in Basil's current watering selection and renderer implementation.
